teaser: Experts go on the record with signed opinions, readers pay for the ones they value, and the people whose ideas an article uses get a share.
core_idea: Instead of a comments section, let experts go on the record on an article with a signed professional opinion they can withdraw; identity comes in levels from an anonymous tap to a key bound to a domain with a track record; readers pay for opinions they value and idea contributors share in revenue; the case for signing is accountability and payment, since the evidence on civility is mixed.
